author: KEXP
description: Psychedelic collective Al-Qasar bring to life a vision of ecstatic rhythm and cultural connection. With raw intensity and their fuzzed-out sound, the band offer a performance of "Tariqi" and more Live on KEXP with host Darek Mazonne.
title: Al-Qasar performs "Tariqi"  more Live on KEXP
